newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Three Bosnian children killed in mine blast.
newsitem.headline: Three Bosnian children killed in mine blast.

text.p: Three Bosnian children were killed in a mine explosion on Sunday in a Sarajevo suburb, police and NATO officers said.

Bosnian authorities said they died in the village of Sovrle in the Ilias suburb, west of the city centre. "They were killed in a minefield," said Major Tony White, spokesman for the NATO-led peace force in Bosnia.
The incident was still under investigation and no further details were immediately available, police said.
Bosnia is littered with mines after four years of war. Rival armies have pledged to remove those near former front lines but in many cases there is no record of where they were laid.
